newsitem.title: GERMANY: German airline chief sees Euro airfares falling.
newsitem.headline: German airline chief sees Euro airfares falling.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa chief Juergen Weber reckons European airfares will fall around three to four percent a year after liberalisation of European air markets on April 1 this year, a report on Wednesday said.

The German business magazine Wirtschaftswoche on Wednesday quoted Weber as saying the effects of competition would be seen most clearly on the large European hub airports such as Frankfurt, London, Brussels, Amsterdam und Paris.
He also said certain internal routes could see among the sharpest price falls as new entrants appeared in national markets.
